band.label: Report status and actions
band.asAtLabel: Value the stock as at this day
band.exportHeld: Nothing to export yet: the report has no rows.

scope.label: What the report shows
scope.search: Search an item, a lot or a work order
scope.privacy: Per item, lot, site and work order: never per person.

method.title: How the values are made
method.none: No stock is valued on this day, so no costing method applies.
method.several: The companies in view use different costing methods: choose one site to read one method.

company.UNDECIDED: Costing method: not chosen yet. The accountant chooses it (standard, moving average or FIFO, c.c. art. 2426); until then these values are provisional.
company.STANDARD: Costing method: standard cost. A value marked "depends on the method" may differ under it.
company.MOVING_AVERAGE: Costing method: moving average. A value marked "depends on the method" may differ under it.
company.FIFO: Costing method: FIFO. A value marked "depends on the method" may differ under it.

method.ledger: Each value is the stock ledger's, as each move was valued: receipts at their purchase order's price, issues at the lot's average cost, opening stock and finished garments at the standard cost. Work in progress is the work order's cost ledger.
method.accountant: To confirm with the accountant: the costing method, and whether to revalue what was posted before it is chosen.
method.noCost: Values need the cost grain (money.cost): quantities, areas and hides are shown; the value columns are not drawn.

totals.title: Totals by category
totals.failed: The totals could not be read.

note.truncated: Only the first 5,000 rows are shown: narrow the report by site or category.
note.unvalued_one: {count} stock move has no value yet: its stock is counted but not valued.
note.unvalued_other: {count} stock moves have no value yet: their stock is counted but not valued.
note.residue: {residue} is left by the rounding of lot costs on stock that is gone: rows plus this equal the stock ledger.
note.currencies: The stock is valued in more than one currency: no total is added across them.

empty.title: No stock on this date
empty.body: Nothing was on hand at the end of {day}.

noMatch.title: Nothing matches
noMatch.body: No stock matches the site, the category or the search.

row.wipOpen: The work order's cost so far
row.wipDone: Work order done: its balance is the variance the close writes off

basis.none_one: No value: {count} move has no cost
basis.none_other: No value: {count} moves have no cost

how.title: How this lot is valued
how.failed: Couldn't read how it is valued.

companyMethod.UNDECIDED: Not chosen yet (to confirm with the accountant)

how.depends: A chosen costing method may value it differently.
how.same: The company's method values it the same.
how.before: The latest {count} moves are shown; before them: {quantity}, {value}.
how.noMoves: No move up to this day.
how.accountant: Whether to revalue these moves once a method is chosen is the accountant's question.

reason.PRODUCTION_RECEIPT: Finished goods from a work order

print.title: Stock valuation · {company} · as at {day}
print.held: Wait until the report is read.

noAccess.title: You cannot see the stock valuation
noAccess.body: It needs the stock permission (inventory.stock.view). Ask an administrator.

problem.signed_out: Your session ended: sign in again.
problem.forbidden: You may not see this stock (a site outside your roles).
problem.not_found: This item or lot no longer exists.
problem.unavailable: The factory system did not answer: try again.
problem.rate_limited: Too many reads at once: wait a moment.
problem.invalid: The day or a filter is not valid.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side.
